1. Read the three CSV/TSV files (NO2 values, Crime values, neighbour list) into pandas DataFrames.  
2. Merge the NO2 and Crime tables on borough name to obtain one table with columns [borough, NO2_value, Crime_value].  
3. Handle missing data: drop any borough that has a missing value in NO2_value or Crime_value (list-wise deletion). Record the remaining borough list.  
4. From the neighbour file, keep only neighbour pairs in which both boroughs survived the missing-value deletion.  
5. Build an n × n binary spatial‐weights matrix W where W[i,j] = 1 if borough i is listed as a neighbour of borough j, else 0 (set W[i,i] = 0). Compute S₀ = Σ₁ Σⱼ W[i,j] for later use.  
6. Compute Lee’s L statistic:  
   a. Let x = NO2 values, y = Crime values, x̄ and ȳ their means.  
   b. Numerator N = Σᵢ Σⱼ W[i,j] (xᵢ − x̄)(yⱼ − ȳ).  
   c. Denominator D = sqrt[ Σᵢ(xᵢ − x̄)² * Σⱼ(yⱼ − ȳ)² ].  
   d. L = ((n − 1)/S₀) * N / D.  
7. Assess significance with a permutation test (n_perms = 999; ≥500 minimum):  
   • Keep NO2 fixed; randomly shuffle Crime values among boroughs each permutation, recompute L.  
   • Build the empirical permutation distribution of L.  
   • Two-sided p-value = ((#|L_perm| ≥ |L_obs|) + 1)/(n_perms + 1).  
8. Decision rule:  
   • If p < 0.05 and L_obs > 0 → report “POSITIVE”.  
   • If p < 0.05 and L_obs < 0 → report “NEGATIVE”.  
   • Otherwise → report “NOT SIGNIFICANT”.  
9. Report the observed Lee’s L and p-value rounded to three decimal places in the required one-line format.  

Missing-value policy: rows (boroughs) with any NA in either variable are removed before steps 4–9; all subsequent calculations and permutations use this reduced, complete-data set only.

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# ----------------------------
# 1. Load data
# ----------------------------
DATA_PATH = "chunks_csv/bivariate/bivariate_2022_no2_crime.csv"
ADJ_PATH  = "chunks_csv/borough_adjacency.csv"

df = pd.read_csv(DATA_PATH)              # columns: borough, NO2_value, Crime_value
adj = pd.read_csv(ADJ_PATH)              # columns: borough, neighbor

# ----------------------------
# 2. Drop rows with any NA
# ----------------------------
df_clean = df.dropna(subset=["NO2_value", "Crime_value"]).reset_index(drop=True)
boroughs = df_clean["borough"].tolist()
n = len(boroughs)

# Keep only adjacency pairs where both ends survive the NA-removal
adj_clean = adj[adj["borough"].isin(boroughs) & adj["neighbor"].isin(boroughs)]

# ----------------------------
# 3. Build spatial-weights matrix W (binary, symmetric, zero diagonal)
# ----------------------------
index = {b: i for i, b in enumerate(boroughs)}
W = np.zeros((n, n), dtype=float)

for _, row in adj_clean.iterrows():
    i = index[row["borough"]]
    j = index[row["neighbor"]]
    W[i, j] = 1          # directed edge as listed
    W[j, i] = 1          # symmetrize

np.fill_diagonal(W, 0)
S0 = W.sum()

# ----------------------------
# 4. Prepare variables
# ----------------------------
x = df_clean["NO2_value"].to_numpy(dtype=float)
y = df_clean["Crime_value"].to_numpy(dtype=float)
x_mean = x.mean()
y_mean = y.mean()

# ----------------------------
# 5. Lee’s L statistic
# ----------------------------
num = ((x - x_mean)[:, None] * (y - y_mean)[None, :]) * W
N_stat = num.sum()
D_stat = np.sqrt(((x - x_mean) ** 2).sum() * ((y - y_mean) ** 2).sum())
L_obs = ((n - 1) / S0) * N_stat / D_stat

# ----------------------------
# 6. Permutation test (999 permutations)
# ----------------------------
rng = np.random.default_rng(seed=0)
perm_L = []
n_perms = 999

for _ in range(n_perms):
    y_perm = rng.permutation(y)
    num_perm = ((x - x_mean)[:, None] * (y_perm - y_mean)[None, :]) * W
    N_perm = num_perm.sum()
    L_perm = ((n - 1) / S0) * N_perm / D_stat
    perm_L.append(L_perm)

perm_L = np.array(perm_L)

# two-sided p-value
p_val = (np.sum(np.abs(perm_L) >= abs(L_obs)) + 1) / (n_perms + 1)

# ----------------------------
# 7. Determine direction & significance
# ----------------------------
if p_val < 0.05:
    verdict = "POSITIVE" if L_obs > 0 else "NEGATIVE"
else:
    verdict = "NOT SIGNIFICANT"

# ----------------------------
# 8. Print results
# ----------------------------
print(f"data_points_used = {n}")
print(f"FINAL ANSWER: {verdict} (test statistic = {L_obs:.6f}, p = {p_val:.6f})")
